## Real-time (Socket.IO)

`useRealtime()` (from `src/realtime/RealtimeContext.jsx`) connects to the backend composer's `realtime-socketio*` module and shows a live "who's online" list — pair the two and it works out of the box, same as the Auth module.

- The socket only opens once `useAuth()` has an `accessToken` — Socket.IO's handshake carries it as `auth: { token }`, matching the backend's expectation, and closes automatically on logout.
- `presence:update` events (broadcast whenever anyone joins/leaves) update `online`, an array of `{ id, name }` for everyone currently connected — `PresenceList` in `src/components/` renders it, and is what's dropped into `src/App.jsx` by default.

Set `VITE_SOCKET_URL` in `.env` to your backend's *origin* (no path — defaults to `http://localhost:4000`, matching the backend composer's default port). This is deliberately separate from `VITE_API_URL` (which includes `/api/v1`): Socket.IO connects directly to the server origin and does its own path-based routing (`/socket.io/`) underneath.
